run_cutlass_moe_fp8: run CUTLASS fused MoE inference with FP8 quantized weights and per-activation-token or per-output-channel scaling
run_cutlass_moe_fp4: run CUTLASS fused MoE inference with NVFP4 quantized weights and block-scale quantization
run_cutlass_moe_mxfp4: run CUTLASS fused MoE inference with MXFP4 quantized weights using grouped GEMM
run_cutlass_moe_w4a8_fp8: run CUTLASS fused MoE inference with W4A8 quantized weights using per-token FP8 activation scales
cutlass_moe_w4a8_fp8: compute W4A8-quantized MoE layer output using CUTLASS mixed-dtype grouped GEMM with top-k gating
